title: Instruction transfer matrix pilot: registered "similar" pairs do not predict where task cards transfer; the visible structure is a generic gain plus answer-channel conflict, at a noise floor as large as the effects
purpose: Purpose 2 (generalisation: evolve on one benchmark, evaluate on the others). The pilot measures directly whether instruction text written for benchmark i helps benchmark j, and whether the registered similar pairs (SearchQA<->OfficeQA, OfficeQA<->LiveMath, OfficeQA<->SpreadsheetBench) are the pairs where it does. It also measures the noise floor and power that any "evolve on one, evaluate on the rest" metric will face.
verdict_cn:
【E4：把五张"任务说明卡"交叉用到别的题库上，看"相似"到底指什么】

一、做了什么
- 五个题库各有一张人工写的"任务说明卡"（就是 I-ds 链起步时用的那五段做题说明；I-ds = 用说明卡起步的那条进化链）。
- 我们把每张卡放到别的题库的题目上去做，再和"什么说明都不加的空白模板"比。
- 表格题库（SpreadsheetBench，要在 docker 这个隔离环境里真的运行程序才能打分）和家务模拟题库（ALFWorld，每道题要花几万到十几万 token，token 是模型读写文字的计量单位）太重，所以没当"考场"，只把它们的卡拿来当"被试说明"。
- 实际用了 3 个考场：搜索问答 SearchQA、财政文档问答 OfficeQA、数学选择题 LiveMath。每个考场 30 到 41 道训练题，大多做两遍，一共 1,222 次作答。
- 共花约 368 万 token，在 400 万预算内。只用训练题，没碰任何测试题。

二、主要答案：事先登记的"相似题库对"预测不了说明卡能不能迁移
- 登记为相似的组合，平均比空白模板高 1.2 分；不相似的组合平均高 1.1 分。这里的"分"都指通过率的百分点。
- 两者之差是 +0.1 分，误差范围从 −5.6 到 +5.5 分，也就是说没有差别。
- 登记为相似的"表格卡→文档问答"反而是全表第二大的伤害（−20 分）。

三、真正看得到的规律，只有两条粗的
- (1) 任何一张问答类说明卡，放进任何一个问答考场，都比空白模板高约 7 分。
- 而且题库"自己的那张卡"并不比别的问答卡更好（差 −0.6 到 +5 分，都在误差范围内）。所以说明卡的帮助大多是"通用"的。
- (2) 要求换一种作答方式的卡，只在文档问答上造成大伤害：家务卡要求输出"动作"标签（−27 分），表格卡要求写 Python 程序（−20 分）。同样的卡在搜索问答和数学上几乎没影响。
- 所以"相似"更像是"作答格式是否一致"，而不是"题目内容像不像"。注意：这第二条规律只在文档问答一个考场上成立。

四、测量噪声和效果一样大
- 同一段说明、同一批题，隔几分钟再做一遍，约十分之一的题会对错翻转。
- 空白模板自己的两遍之间，就差了 −12.5 分（搜索问答）和 +9.8 分（数学）。
- 同一个格子，第一遍和第二遍算出来的"提升"互相对不上：相关系数是 −0.5，平均相差 9.3 分。
- 换一天做：在同样 200 道搜索题上，空白模板掉了 5.9 分，带说明卡的版本几乎不动。
- 所以跨天比较、或者拿空白模板当对照，都不可靠。

五、发现一个可以修的毛病
- 同一个请求在 1 秒内连发两次时，第二次的回答常常换了格式（不写答案标签）。空白模板这种没写标签的回答一共 7 次，全部是这种"紧挨着重发"的第二次。
- 两次请求隔 2 分钟以上时，一次翻转也没有。
- 搜索问答上，每张卡"多做对"的 6 到 8 道题里，有 5 道就来自这个毛病。
- 以后凡是重复测量，都要把两次请求隔开。

六、题量决定能看出多小的差别
- 要把误差压到正负 5 分，搜索问答要约 115 题，文档问答要约 228 题，数学要约 146 题。
- 但文档问答的训练题只有 74 道，家务题只有 57 道。无论花多少钱，这两个题库都只能看出 9 分左右以上的差别。
- 一条学到的规则，效果远小于一整张说明卡。所以在这两个题库上，靠原有题目几乎不可能证明规则能迁移。

七、顺带发现（建议交给 D7 方向，D7 专门研究数学题的特殊选项）
- 数学题库全部 283 道训练题里，有 129 道带"其余某个选项正确，但能证明更强的结论"这个特殊选项。
- 这 129 道的正确答案，全部就是这个选项。空白模板一次也没选过它。
- 这是数据本身的规律。用它写规则算不算"泄题"，需要单独决定。

建议
- 不要再用事先登记的相似对当泛化的尺子。
- 评估时，对照组用"同一时段、同一批题、交错发送"的强说明卡，不要用空白模板。
- 评估题库要挑训练题多的（至少约 300 道），并且作答格式要和进化用的题库一致。
- 如果要做完整矩阵：3 个问答考场约需 1,500 万 token、8 到 10 小时；再加表格考场约 200 到 300 万 token；家务考场约 3,000 万 token。

可行性：中等。做得出来，但只能看出粗的结构，看不出细的"内容相似"。

evidence:
ALL MEASURED unless marked. Pilot: deepseek-v4-flash, thinking off, temperature 0, max_tokens 32768, PJLAB token route, frozen v3 solve/score/classify code. Items are TRAINING items: the first N of the registered v3 order (DATA_SEED 20261017). Card i sits in TARGET j's section; the other sections are an empty scaffold. Identity checks: the scaffold equals the v3 E-ds Skill hash (true); the all-five render equals v3 I-ds (true). Complete items (every arm, every planned run scored): SearchQA 40, OfficeQA 30, LiveMath 41. SearchQA and LiveMath have 2 runs per arm. On OfficeQA the scaffold has 2 runs and each card 1. 0 unknown cells. 14 truncations (13 on OfficeQA).

MATRIX. Delta = card minus empty scaffold, in points, with 95% item bootstrap (10k), up/down item counts and exact sign-test p. SIM marks a registered similar pair.
- SearchQA card: ->S diag +7.5 [+0.0,+16.2] 7/2 p=.18; ->O SIM +13.3 [+1.7,+26.7] 5/1 p=.22; ->L +6.1 [-2.4,+15.9] 6/3.
- OfficeQA card: ->S SIM +8.8 [+1.2,+17.5] 6/1 p=.12; ->O diag +10.0 [+0.0,+23.3] 4/1; ->L SIM +7.3 [-1.2,+17.1] 7/3.
- LiveMath card: ->S +7.5 [+0.0,+15.0] 8/2; ->O SIM -3.3 [-18.3,+10.0] 3/3; ->L diag +8.5 [+1.2,+17.1] 6/1 p=.12.
- SpreadsheetBench card: ->S +3.8 [-6.2,+13.8]; ->O SIM -20.0 [-33.3,-8.3] 0/7 p=.016; ->L +12.2 [+2.4,+23.2] 9/2 p=.07.
- ALFWorld card: ->S +5.0 [-2.5,+13.8]; ->O -26.7 [-43.3,-13.3] 0/9 p=.0039; ->L 0.0 [-11.0,+9.8].
- Pass rates (scaffold / cards S,O,L,Sh,A): S 58.8 / 66.2, 67.5, 66.2, 62.5, 63.8; O 33.3 / 46.7, 43.3, 30.0, 13.3, 6.7; L 31.7 / 37.8, 39.0, 40.2, 43.9, 31.7.
- No cell has a sign-test p below the Bonferroni threshold 0.05/15 = 0.0033.
- Run-0-only matrix: the SearchQA column is +4.7, +4.7, +4.7, -2.3, -4.7 (all unresolved). OfficeQA: -23.3 (Sh) and -30.0 (A) are harms. LiveMath: O +13.6 (6/0, p=.03), L +11.4, Sh +18.2 (8/0, p=.008).

H1, registered similarity (pre-registered): mean of the 5 similar cells minus the 7 dissimilar = +0.1 [-5.6,+5.5]; run-0 only +0.1 [-6.3,+6.3]. Group means: similar +1.22, dissimilar +1.13. Not supported. Similar cells: 2 positive, 2 unresolved, 1 harm. Dissimilar cells: 1 positive (Sh->L), 1 harm (A->O).

H2, answer-channel compatibility (pre-registered): +11.6 [+5.4,+18.3]; run-0 only +14.6 [+8.0,+21.1]. Post hoc, OfficeQA target only: +30.0 [+14.4,+46.7]. Without the OfficeQA target: +1.7 [-3.5,+7.5].

POST HOC:
- Own card minus the mean of the other two QA cards: S -0.6 [-8.1,+5.6], O +5.0 [-5.0,+15.0], L +1.8 [-6.7,+9.8].
- Mean of the 3 QA cards minus scaffold: S +7.9 [+1.7,+15.0], O +6.7 [-2.2,+16.1], L +7.3 [+0.8,+14.6].

NOISE, same text, same session:
- Discordant item-pairs, run 1 vs run 0: SearchQA 22/240 (5 up/17 down, p=.017); LiveMath 24/246 (14/10); OfficeQA scaffold 2/30.
- Scaffold run1-run0: SearchQA -12.5 [-22.5,-2.5] (0/5); LiveMath +9.8 [+2.4,+19.5] (4/0).
- Cell replication over the 10 two-run cells: Pearson -0.50; mean |run0-run1| = 9.3 points.

SEND-TIMING ARTEFACT:
- All 5 SearchQA scaffold flips (pass->fail) were second sends 0-1 s after an identical request; 4 of the 5 switched to untagged prose (e.g. 'The answer is **burrito**.').
- All 7 untagged scaffold replies were second sends.
- 0 flips in the 23 pairs sent at least 120 s apart, vs 5/17 back-to-back (Fisher p ~ 0.009, post hoc).
- 5 of the 6-8 items each card gained on SearchQA are exactly those items.

CROSS-SESSION DRIFT (same text, same items):
- Fresh scaffold minus v3 E-ds: S -2.5 [-11.2,+6.2], O +15.0 [+3.3,+28.3] (5/0), L -9.8 [-19.5,-1.2] (2/7).
- cal-1 scaffold minus v3 E-ds on all 200 SearchQA items: -5.9 [-9.9,-1.9], 14/41, p=.0004. cal-1 all-five minus v3 I-ds: -0.5 [-2.8,+1.6] (n=199).
- The SearchQA card-vs-empty effect: v3 +3.3 [-0.3,+6.8] (n=200), cal-1 +8.4 [+4.4,+12.5] (n=200), this pilot +7.5 (n=40).
- cal-1 same-text null (parent:B - parent:A): +0.3 [-1.8,+2.3] (n=200).
- cal-1 four other cards in their own sections: +0.2 [-3.1,+3.6] (n=199).

LIVEMATH META OPTION (training pool):
- 129 of 283 items contain 'One of the remaining options is correct, but a stronger result can be proven.' In 129/129 it is the key; 154 items have no meta option.
- Pilot: the scaffold picked the meta option in 0/82 cells; cards picked it in 3.7-7.3% of cells.

POWER: median item-delta SD is S 0.273, O 0.385, L 0.307. Items needed for a 5-point half-width: 115 / 228 / 146; for 3 points: 318 / 634 / 404. Training pools: S 600, O 74, L 283, SpreadsheetBench 120, ALFWorld 57.
design:
As executed:
- Arms: 6 (the empty scaffold plus each of the 5 v3 manifest task cards).
- Targets: 3 (SearchQA, OfficeQA, LiveMath), giving 15 cells.
- Placement: card i is rendered inside target j's section, under j's fixed heading and "Applies when" line, i.e. the "similar"-placement analog. The other sections are an empty scaffold.
- Code: the frozen v3 code (renderer, training draw nested in the v3 order, solver prompt, native scorers, outcome table).
- Sends: 6 workers. Resends after 60 s. After 00:51, twin runs were lagged (median gap ~390 s) instead of sent back-to-back.
- Cap: a token cap checked at admission.
- Analysis: pre-registered (complete items, item bootstrap, sign test, H1 and H2 with a target-stratified bootstrap, run-0 sensitivity, noise per arm, v3 drift). Post-hoc additions are labelled.

SpreadsheetBench and ALFWorld targets were not run:
- SpreadsheetBench needs docker execution plus the v3 re-execute/rescore/cleanup logic outside the pipeline.
- ALFWorld costs 28k-106k tokens per episode (estimate ~29M tokens for this design).

Recommended v5 design for the generalisation metric:
(1) Reference arm: the target's own task card or a strong generic instruction, measured in the same session and interleaved. Never the empty scaffold, which is the least stable arm.
(2) Twin sends at least 120 s apart, or in randomised order. No identical request twice within a second.
(3) Define "similar" empirically, from a measured same-session transfer matrix. Expect the answer channel or format to dominate, not the topic.
(4) Choose evaluation benchmarks with at least ~300 training-pool items and the same answer channel as the evolution benchmark. On native pools OfficeQA (74) and ALFWorld (57) can only show effects above ~9 points.
(5) If the full matrix is wanted: 3 QA targets x 7 arms (5 cards + scaffold + generic) x 2 lagged runs, at 115 / 74 / 146 items (~4,700 cells). Add the SpreadsheetBench target through the pipeline executor. Report the run-0-only and stratified contrasts beside the pooled ones.

pilot.result: Run: 1,222 of 1,650 planned cells scored (cap bound at 02:07:21), 0 unknown, 14 truncations. Tokens: 3,558,474 in the run ledger + 117,695 smoke = 3,676,169. Matrix: 3 QA targets x 5 cards, with 30-41 complete items per target. Findings: (1) H1 (registered similar minus dissimilar) +0.1 [-5.6,+5.5], not supported. (2) Generic QA-card gain ~+7 on every QA target. The own card is not better than another QA card. (3) Conflicting answer channels hurt on OfficeQA only: ALFWorld card -26.7, SpreadsheetBench card -20.0. H2 +11.6 [+5.4,+18.3], but +1.7 [-3.5,+7.5] without OfficeQA. (4) Noise floor ~10% of items flip between runs of the same text; the cell estimates of the two runs correlate at -0.50. (5) Identical requests sent within 1 s return reformatted, untagged answers, which inflates the SearchQA column. (6) The empty scaffold drifts across days (-5.9 on 200 items). (7) LiveMath training pool: the meta option is present in 129/283 items and is always the key.

risks:
- Small n: 30-41 complete items per target, and the OfficeQA cards ran once. Every "positive" cell rests on 6-9 discordant items. No cell survives a 15-cell multiplicity correction by sign test.
- Only 3 of 5 targets were run, so the similar pair OfficeQA->SpreadsheetBench and both heavy targets are unmeasured.
- About the first 40% of SearchQA and LiveMath twin pairs were sent back-to-back (artefact). The run-0-only matrix is the cleaner read for SearchQA.
- Placement in the target's own section is one design. Cards left in their own sections behave differently (cal-1: +0.2 interference on SearchQA).
- The H2 support comes from one target (OfficeQA, n=30).
- The send-timing mechanism is a measured association; its cause on the PJLAB route is unknown.
- The cal-1 comparisons assume, from cal-1's registration, that its parent arms are the v3 E-ds scaffold. Hash conventions differ and this was not re-verified here.
- The LiveMath meta-option regularity concerns the training pool only; the test pool was not examined, by rule. Turning it into a rule is a leakage-policy decision (D7).
- report.md was not written: the harness blocks subagent report files. The content is in this output.
cost_estimate:
Already spent (measured): 3,676,169 tokens, ~2 h 10 min wall time at 6 workers. Measured mean tokens per cell: SearchQA 1,749, OfficeQA 8,647, LiveMath 1,546.

Full-study estimates:
- 3 QA targets x 7 arms x 2 lagged runs at 115 / 74 (whole pool) / 146 items: ~4,700 cells, ~15M tokens, ~8-10 h at 6 workers.
- 3-point half-widths on SearchQA and LiveMath (318 / 404 items; OfficeQA capped at 74): ~26M tokens.
- SpreadsheetBench target (120 items x 6 arms x 1 run): ~1.4-3.1M tokens plus docker time (v3: 2,010-4,273 tokens per cell).
- ALFWorld target (57 items x 6 arms x 2 runs): ~29M tokens (v3: 28,463 tokens per scaffold episode, 105,651 per all-five episode; ~45k per single-card episode, estimated).
recommendation:
1) Retire the registered similarity map as the generalisation yardstick. This pilot finds no similar-vs-dissimilar difference (+0.1 [-5.6,+5.5]), and one registered pair (SpreadsheetBench card -> OfficeQA) is a large harm. Define similarity by the measured answer channel/format, and treat it as an empirical property re-measured in the same session.
2) In every transfer, gate or evaluation measurement, compare against a strong instruction run in the same session with interleaved sends, never against the empty scaffold or another day's numbers.
3) Fix the send schedule in the v4/v5 harness: identical twin requests at least 120 s apart, or in randomised order. Re-check whether the v3 gate's repeated runs were sent back-to-back.
4) For "evolve on one, evaluate on the rest", evolve on SearchQA or LiveMath and evaluate on benchmarks with at least ~300 training items and the same answer channel. Do not expect OfficeQA (74) or ALFWorld (57) to show a learned rule's transfer; they need generated items (D6/D12) or a larger replacement benchmark.
5) Send the LiveMath meta-option finding (129/129 training items: the meta option is the key whenever present) to D7 and the leakage-policy owner before any LiveMath rule is learned or judged.
6) A full matrix is affordable (~15M tokens for the QA targets) but would mostly re-measure the generic gain and the channel conflict. Run it only if the paper needs that table, and add a generic-instruction arm plus lagged sends.
